title: Pro-etale scalar mate restricts to the specified projection arrow
statement:
Let $a:A\to B$ be a map of finite commutative rings and $u:T\to V$ any scheme map. Use ordinary unbounded constant-ring module derived categories on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Put $S_W=-\otimes^L_{A_W}B_W$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] and let $U_W$ be exact scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. The scalar adjunction $S_W\dashv U_W$ is the representative-normalized one of [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. Let $\lambda_u:u_B^{-1}S_V\xrightarrow{\sim}S_Tu_A^{-1}$ be the canonical tensor inverse-image comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. For $M\in D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ let $\chi_{u,M}:S_VRu_*^AM\to Ru_*^BS_TM$ be the $u_B^{-1}\dashv Ru_*^B$ adjunct [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of $S_T(\varepsilon^A_{u,M})\circ\lambda_{u,Ru_*^AM}$. Under the canonical identifications $U_WS_WN\cong N\otimes_A^LB_W$ and $U_VRu_*^B\cong Ru_*^AU_T$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction], restriction of $\chi_{u,M}$ is the specified projection morphism $\pi^A_{u;M,B_V}$ of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact]. In particular its counit equation is
$$\varepsilon^B_{u,S_TM}\circ u_B^{-1}(\chi_{u,M})=S_T(\varepsilon^A_{u,M})\circ\lambda_{u,Ru_*^AM}.$$
All identifications are natural and no boundedness or flatness of $a$ is assumed.
